title: Stage 2 backtest-engine acceptance specification
declaration_note: This file states what the engine must do and what counts as detecting a defect, including every expected number in the hand-calculated fixtures. It was written before any backtest engine code existed. Sealing the acceptance criteria after the engine could run would let the engine define correctness for itself, which is the exact failure gate 2 exists to prevent.

conditions: deterministic reruns produce identical trades and equity curves
tests detect look-ahead, same-close fill, split/dividend, delisting, stale-price, cash, rounding, fee, slippage, rejected-order, and duplicate-order errors
independent hand-calculated fixtures match engine output

determinism.requirement: two runs of the same probe over the same window with the same config produce byte-identical serialised trade lists and equity curves
determinism.comparison_method: SHA-256 of the canonical-JSON serialisation of the trade list and of the equity curve
determinism.arithmetic: all cash, quantity, price, and fee arithmetic uses decimal.Decimal; no floating-point value enters a cash or quantity computation
determinism.arithmetic_rationale: Decimal removes binary rounding drift as a source of run-to-run difference and makes every fixture value reproducible by hand.
determinism.iteration_order: symbols are iterated in sorted order at every step; no set or dict iteration order is ever relied on
determinism.no_wall_clock_in_results: no timestamp, run id, or path appears inside the hashed trade list or equity curve

defect_classes.note: One entry per error class named in gate 2. 'split/dividend' is one phrase but two independent errors, so it is split into two entries. Each entry names the mutation a test must inject and the mechanism that must catch it. A class is only satisfied if the clean engine passes AND the mutated engine is caught.

classes.error: a decision uses information not available before its simulated decision time
classes.mutation: a probe asks the market view for a bar at or after the session following the decision session
classes.detector: LookAheadError raised by the market view, which is constructed with a hard visibility bound and cannot be widened by the caller

classes.error: an order generated from a session's close is filled at that same close
classes.mutation: a fill is submitted for the decision session itself rather than the next session
classes.detector: FillTimingError raised by the order book, which requires fill_session to be strictly after decision_session and to be the next eligible exchange session

classes.error: a split is applied to the share count of an already split-adjusted series, applying the same event twice
classes.mutation: share count multiplied by the recorded split ratio on the split session
classes.detector: value-continuity invariant across every corporate-action session: marked position value may not jump by the split ratio; CorporateActionError

classes.error: a dividend is credited on the wrong session, at the wrong amount, or twice
classes.mutation: credit the dividend on the session after the ex-date, and separately credit it twice
classes.detector: benchmark reconciliation between the provider adjustment factor and the explicit reinvestment model, plus a per-event cash-credit assertion in the fixture

classes.error: a position is carried, and valued, past the end of the symbol's price series
classes.mutation: extend the run beyond a symbol's last session while holding it, without liquidating
classes.detector: the engine liquidates at the last available close and marks the symbol ineligible; DelistingError if a position survives its symbol's final session

classes.error: an order fills, or a mark is taken as fresh, using a bar older than the session it is attributed to
classes.mutation: remove a bar from the middle of a series while the calendar still reports a session
classes.detector: fills rejected with STALE_PRICE; the equity point flagged stale; a stale run longer than the declared limit raises DataIntegrityHalt

classes.error: cash is created, destroyed, or driven negative
classes.mutation: fill an order larger than available cash; skip the cash debit on a fill
classes.detector: the cash-conservation invariant checked after every event: closing cash equals opening cash minus debits plus credits, exactly, in Decimal; and cash may never be negative
classes.constitution_ref: section 5.1, no order may create negative cash or leverage

classes.error: a rounding step favours the account, or an order below the minimum notional is silently rounded up instead of rejected
classes.mutation: round share quantity up instead of down; round a buy notional down instead of up
classes.detector: the adverse-rounding invariant: for a buy, charged notional is greater than or equal to quantity times effective price; for a sell and for dividend cash, credited amount is less than or equal to it; MIN_NOTIONAL rejection is asserted separately

classes.error: a regulatory fee or commission is omitted, applied to the wrong side, or applied at the wrong rate
classes.mutation: set every fee to zero; apply the sell-side fees to a buy
classes.detector: hand-calculated fixture equality on each fee component, plus the invariant that every fill carries a strictly positive total cost

classes.error: slippage or spread is omitted or applied in the favourable direction
classes.mutation: fill a buy below the reference price and a sell above it
classes.detector: the adverse-price invariant asserted on every fill: effective buy price is strictly greater than the reference, effective sell price is strictly less

classes.error: a rejected order changes cash or positions, or disappears without being recorded
classes.mutation: apply the position and cash effect of an order that was rejected
classes.detector: rejections are recorded with a reason code and asserted to leave cash, position, and equity byte-identical to the pre-order state

classes.error: the same order is admitted twice, or two orders for one symbol are live on one session
classes.mutation: submit an identical order twice on the same session
classes.detector: DuplicateOrderError from the order book, which rejects a repeated deterministic order id and a second live order in the same symbol on the same session

invariants.note: Checked by the engine itself at every event, not only by tests. A violated invariant halts the run; it is never logged and stepped over.
list: CASH_NON_NEGATIVE: cash is never negative at any point in any session
CASH_CONSERVATION: closing cash equals opening cash minus debits plus credits, exactly, in Decimal
CASH_IS_WHOLE_CENTS: cash always has at most two decimal places
NO_LEVERAGE: gross position value never exceeds the declared fraction of equity at the moment of sizing
LONG_ONLY: no position quantity is ever negative
MAX_ONE_RISKY_POSITION: at most one non-cash position is open at any time in Generation 1
ADVERSE_PRICE: every fill price is worse for the account than its reference price
ADVERSE_ROUNDING: every rounding step is adverse to the account
POSITIVE_COST: every fill carries a strictly positive total cost
FILL_AFTER_DECISION: every fill session is strictly later than its decision session
FILL_ON_SESSION: every fill session is an exchange session with a fresh bar for that symbol
NO_POSITION_PAST_LAST_BAR: no position is held past its symbol's final available session

hand_calculated_fixtures.note: Computed by explicit arithmetic before the engine existed, and sealed here. The test asserts engine output equals these values. If the engine disagrees, either the engine or this arithmetic is wrong, and the discrepancy is reported rather than resolved by editing this file.

instrument.probe: enter on the decision at the close of 2015-01-06, exit on the decision at the close of 2015-01-08

entry.regulatory_fees_note: SEC section 31 and FINRA TAF are sell-side only

FIXT_REJECTIONS.note: Reason codes, not amounts. Each case must leave cash, position, and equity exactly unchanged.

cases.case: order notional below the declared minimum
order requiring more cash than is available
second order for the same symbol on the same decision session
fill session has no bar for the symbol
order that would open a second simultaneous risky position
sell of more shares than are held
entry submitted while the research drawdown shutdown is active

FIXT_SPLIT_CONTINUITY.note: A recorded split on an already split-adjusted series must not change the share count and must not move marked value.
FIXT_SPLIT_CONTINUITY.expected_marked_value_jump: none beyond the ordinary price step

benchmark_reconciliation.window_rule: validation and holdout data are not read by this stage under any circumstance
benchmark_reconciliation.method_a: ADJ_CLOSE_RATIO: adj_close at the window end divided by adj_close at the window start, minus one
benchmark_reconciliation.method_b: EXPLICIT_DIVIDEND_REINVESTMENT: one share at the window start, each dividend buying additional shares at the close of the session before the ex-date less the dividend amount, valued at the window-end close
benchmark_reconciliation.identity_claim: the two methods are algebraically identical given the provider adjustment convention Stage 1 measured, so any disagreement is a defect and not a modelling choice
additional_checks: the cash benchmark at 0% returns exactly zero over any window
the do-nothing benchmark returns exactly zero and records zero trades
a tradable SPY buy-and-hold run under the full base cost model returns strictly less than the frictionless index figure

window_policy.enforcement: stockedge100.backtest.window raises WindowViolation on any attempt to load or read a session outside the authorized window, and the boundaries are read from governance/STAGE_1_HOLDOUT_LOCK.json rather than restated
window_policy.rationale: Gate 2 validates an engine. It does not need, and is not authorised to read, validation or holdout data. The restriction is enforced in code and asserted by test rather than left to discipline.

probes.note: Engine test instruments, not strategies. Each is a fixed mechanical schedule with no signal, no parameter, no fitting, and no selection. Constitution section 8 governs strategies; none of these is one, and none produces a research result.

declared.behaviour: enter on a named decision session, exit on a named decision session
enter on the first eligible decision session, never exit

prohibited_at_stage_2: any rule conditioned on a price, an indicator, or a return
any parameter chosen by looking at an outcome
any comparison of probe results used to prefer one rule over another
